title: Add option to run tshark with profile from global profiles
description:
Add --global-profile option in tshark. When enabled, it would run tsharkwith profiles from global profiles.

Fixes #19942

This doesn't work for several reasons:
* You can use both `-C <profile>` and `--no-profile`. From the code it looks like all logic for `-C` will still apply (check if exists as personal, copy to personal if needed, etc.). I think a global profile will be used instead of "no profile". This does not match a `--no-profile` option.
* You can use `-o <name>:<value>` to override preference setting. Here the preference loading is opposite.
From the comments in !19944 I think we should look at a `--prefer-system-profile` or something like this instead of making a preference just for "no profile".

Do you think it would be a good idea just to change the directory in which we are looking for profiles? (So, removing from my code the line in which I am setting the profile to be the `DEFAULT` profile (the global one, that wireshark / tshark comes with).

In this way, we can combine the logic with `-C option` since the folder we are looking into is the global one and no copy would be performed. 

Should I proceed with this @stigbjorlykke ?
I think we should collect ideas in the issue before continue implementation. We should be able to cover more use cases with few new options.

The `--prefer-system-profile` doesn't match the implementation because it doesn't fallback to a personal profile if the global profile does not exist, it only uses the global profile. I'm not sure what happens if the profile does not exist as global (`tshark -C personal_profile --prefer-system-profile`). The option with this implementation should be something like `--use-global-profile` or `--global-profile`.

The profile provided with `-C` is still validated from personal profiles, not global profiles.

I have modified the PR to check first for the option with `--global-profile` and change the profile path if the option is present.

If it is, then when checking the profile, no copy would be performed (since, if now the path of checking is the global path).
This documentation should be put together with `-C <config profile>`.

commits_data.title: Add option to run tshark with profile from global profiles
commits_data.message:
Add option to run tshark with profile from global profiles

This commmand introduces the --global-profile option in tshark.
When enabled, it would use the global directory for selecting
profiles.

Fixes #19442
